## Checklist

- [ ] `dart format`, `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass
- [ ] Kotlin unit tests pass (`./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` in `android/`)
- [ ] No secrets, keystores, personal paths or real notification content are included
- [ ] Shared file names or preference keys are changed on both the Dart and Kotlin sides
- [ ] Docs and the changelog are updated when behavior changes
